dct_title_s: Historic District Boundaries - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains the boundaries of Newton's two historic districts.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property, zoning and related urban planning, public works, or policy issues (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: This data layer is maintained on an as-needed basis.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
Data credit: GIS data supplied by City of Newton GIS.
